response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(ili.product_quantity), '') * 1.0) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_quantity DESC) AS color_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_quantity, average_ratio, color_rank FROM ranked WHERE color_rank <= 3

assumptions.assumption: The product color comes from the invoice line item's product_id.
Nonblank quantities contain valid numbers; zero total cost is excluded from the ratio average because the ratio is undefined.
